title: Lemone Lemotha
description: A lightweight Fabric 1.21.11 modpack focused on improved FPS, smoother gameplay, and enhanced UI, featuring essential libraries, performance mods, and quality-of-life enhancements.
body:
🔥 **Lightweight and Fast PvP Modpack** 🔥
BY SWIE9DEV
This Minecraft modpack is designed specifically for **PvP**, offering **smooth performance** and high FPS. It includes essential PvP mods and resource packs that enhance both gameplay and visuals, all set up for immediate play on **Fabric 1.21.11 only**.

✨ **Features:**

* Optimized performan ce for smooth FPS
* Core PvP mods like HUD, CPS, and Keystrokes
* Clean and lightweight resource packs
* Ready-to-play configurations
* Simple and user-friendly interface

🎯 **Who is it for?**
Perfect for anyone who wants a **fast and smooth PvP experience** without heavy shaders, ideal for servers or solo play.

📌 **Compatibility:**

* **Minecraft version: Fabric 1.21.11 only**
